quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James's potential fit and playstyle challenges in Cleveland
quotes.excerpt: he won't be able to play the style of play he's played for the majority of his career
quotes.quote: If LeBron picks Cleveland, everybody in the league will understand it in a second. It's totally fine, but obviously he's weighing certain factors here. Part of it is style of play, and if he goes to Cleveland, he won't be able to play the style of play he's played for the majority of his career where the ball is mostly in his hand because of Donovan Mitchell and James Harden. In Miami, the lead ball-handler role is there.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Defensive rebounding concerns for a potential LeBron, Giannis, and Bam lineup
quotes.excerpt: you're getting one shot. If you're playing these guys, you're getting one shot
quotes.quote: One thing that definitely concerns me about this team is the scoring they lost with their stellar backcourt that they had last year. But from a rebounding standpoint, just with Giannis and Bam, you got two guys that over the last five years are in the top 15 in rebounding. Giannis was third, Bam was 12th, and if you add LeBron James, and this is defensive rebounding, LeBron was 21st. You're getting one shot. If you're playing these guys, you're getting one shot, which I think would certainly make them very daunting defensively.
